about: Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on the uniform K4 EXL3 pack (/mnt/models/nemotron35-exl3-k4, exllamav3 1.6.2, mul1 codebook): every Linear -- Mamba in / out, attention, latent fc1 / fc2, the shared expert, the up-only routed experts, the drafter's -- exl3m_k4 and the head exl3m_k6, byte copies of the pack (--exl3); norms, conv, A_log / D / dt_bias, the router (BF16) and its selection bias (F32) and the embedding from the BF16 checkpoint (--hf) as stored. The drafter (MTP, K4 in the pack) is written; the vision tower is consumed by name (v1: text only).
